content.comment_body: Hello, I purchased a [product_name] with product code [article_no], but the package did not include the adapter for the card in slot x50. Has anyone else experienced this? The package was properly sealed. Where can I find an adapter, is there a specific code I should use to search online?

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please avoid posting the same problem multiple times. You've also created another topic about the [product_name] socket x50. The slot X50 is a module slot for an mSD card, and the package does not come with an mSD card adapter.
Where did you purchase it? Was it on Ebay? [company_name] typically doesn't deliver the [product_name] in this condition.
Thanks for your quick response. I've attached a photo to show what I mean. Is it normal for it to look like this?
[user_name] removed the picture of the [product_name] before I replied. Here it is again!
The SD card slot is missing entirely. If you purchased the [product_name] as a second-hand device...
[user_name] removed the picture of the [product_name] before I replied. Here it is again! Sorry, I hadn't seen it before...

I bought it from an official and trustworthy store, an authorized partner of [company_name]. Is the missing part available for sale separately? I'll visit the store with the device, but if they won't accept it, I'll look for a spare part.
Frankly, I can't imagine an official [company_name] partner selling something like this. The card slot is not available as a spare part.
The slot can only be removed if the device was opened, so there might be additional missing or faulty components. If the seller is reputable (which I doubt), you should request a replacement.
The packaging was sealed with the original tape.
The component cannot be purchased separately. Exchange it! Sorry!
It’s very unlikely this was ever a [product_name] in original packaging. You can only file a complaint.
Please write in English. I've already mentioned this in my previous post...
In your place, I would contact Support. Inform [company_name] directly that you bought a [product_name] in an unopened, original [company_name] package.
Hello—after talking to the store by phone, they advised me to return and exchange the defective unit.

analysis.insight_summary: The user received a [product_name] controller missing the SD card slot and was uncertain about the inclusion of an adapter. The sealed packaging raised questions about product authenticity and completeness, even though it was purchased from an authorized partner. Forum members clarified that adapters aren't included, but the physical slot should not be missing, suggesting possible product tampering and advising the user to seek assistance or replacement from the seller.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all necessary hardware, especially the SD card slot, to be present when purchasing a [product_name] module. They want transparent information about what the package should contain and whether it’s possible to obtain missing components as spare parts.
